Original source note (2026-07-13T19:44:23.13), preserved from supplied workbook:
We believe neoclouds and Tier II CSPs (OCI, xAI) will also continue to aggressively ramp spending into 2027E, with capex estimated at $398B, up 42% y/y, and 2028E estimated at $485B, up 22% y/y, driven by continued drive to add as much capacity as possible. We believe the key drives of neocloud/Tier II CSP capex to be ORCL (Outperform, $320PT), OCI, xAI, CRWV (Neutral, $110PT), NBIS (NC), WULF (NC) and IREN (NC), while we note continued strong spend tailwinds from Fluidstack with Anthropic (Link) and the AVGO/BX (NC)/APO (NC) AI XPV platform, with potential enabling 20GW of capacity longer term
